claims.text: The wait is a hack I added because of the vendor's rate limiting: two requests from the same account within 3 seconds get a 429, and there's no burst allowance.

citations.quote: The vendor returns 429 if two requests from the same account land within 3 seconds
their support confirmed there is no burst allowance

claims.text: Without the delay the nightly batch lost about 8% of quotes. I knew a queue was the proper fix, and the delay was a stopgap.

citations.quote: Without the delay the nightly batch loses about 8% of quotes. Proper fix is a queue.

claims.text: A later change left a TODO saying the delay could go after a migration to a new tax vendor. That suggests the delay is tied to the current vendor's limit, though I can't say whether the migration happened.

citations.quote: // TODO: remove this delay after migrating to the new tax vendor

voice: first-person, a developer explaining his own stopgap
